components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action for joining, saving, publishing, or committing a collector workflow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #DB5428; color: #FFFFFF; min-height: 48px; padding: 16px 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; font: 700 16px/1.2 'DM Sans', sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; box-shadow: 0 20px 32px rgba(242, 107, 58, 0.20); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #F26B3A; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #F26B3A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Subordinate navigation or authentication action next to the primary CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #121820; color: #F4F0E8; min-height: 48px; padding: 16px 28px; border: 1px solid #2B3744; border-radius: 10px; font: 700 16px/1.2 'DM Sans', sans-serif; transition: border-color 200ms ease, background-color 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #1A232D; border-color: #F26B3A; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #F26B3A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Collector Card
components.description: Tonal graphite container for collector information and feature content.
components.html:
COLLECTION INDEX

Digital Checklists

Track every card with precision.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #121820; color: #F4F0E8; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid #2B3744; border-radius: 16px; } .ds-card-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 24px; color: #9BA7B5; font: 600 10px/1.2 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 700 24px/1.2 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #9BA7B5; font: 500 16px/1.5 'DM Sans', sans-serif; }

components.name: Checklist Tile
components.description: Keyboard-operable tile that expands into a shared-layout catalogue preview.
components.css: .ds-checklist-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; min-height: 120px; padding: 20px; background: #121820; border: 1px solid #2B3744; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; transition: border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-checklist-tile:hover { border-color: #F26B3A; } .ds-checklist-tile:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #F26B3A; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-progress { width: 66%; height: 8px; background: #2B3744; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-line { height: 12px; background: #2B3744; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-line-wide { width: 100%; } .ds-line-short { width: 50%; }

narrative.overview: TCG Nexus is a tactile digital collector desk: dark graphite surfaces, indexed labels, warm action ink, and real card imagery create an environment that feels considered and trustworthy. The system is dense enough for catalogue work but calm enough for discovery and community use.

rules.name: The Action Ink Rule
rules.body: Use Ember for the action or state that matters, not as general decoration.

rules.name: The Data Has a Uniform Rule
rules.body: Use IBM Plex Mono only for data, measurement, IDs, and compact catalogue labels.

rules.name: The Tonal Desk Rule
rules.body: Establish depth with surface value and quiet borders before adding shadows.

dos: Do preserve the card and checklist motion language.
Do use one obvious primary action per screen.
Do pair functional color with text, icon, or position.
donts: Don't introduce generic purple SaaS gradients.
Don't use emoji as structural icons.
Don't rely on color alone for state.
